title: Projective monoidal model for unbounded module complexes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Use the cochain and quasi-isomorphism conventions of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The category of all unbounded cochain complexes of $R$-modules has a combinatorial model structure in the sense of [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability]. Its weak equivalences are the quasi-isomorphisms and its fibrations are the termwise surjections. Its cofibrations are the termwise split injections with dg-projective cokernel, where acyclic means zero cohomology in every degree, and a dg-projective complex has projective terms and its Hom complex into every acyclic complex is acyclic. It is closed symmetric monoidal for the direct-sum total tensor with Koszul signs and the product total Hom complex, its unit $R[0]$ is cofibrant, and its pushout product satisfies the condition of [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability]. For $n\in\mathbf Z$, let $S^n$ be $R$ in degree $n$ and zero elsewhere, and let $D^n$ have $R$ in degrees $n,n+1$, differential $d^n=1$, and zero elsewhere. Generating cofibrations are $S^{n+1}\hookrightarrow D^n$ (identity in degree $n+1$), and generating trivial cofibrations are $0\to D^n$, for all integers $n$.
